notes.blurb: Ordinary fabric of a northern Chinese capital: grey brick walls under grey tile, with red-painted timber only at the gate.
notes.construction: Grey brick (stone brick, a share of houses in the greener tuff brick) on an andesite base, deepslate brick bands; timber posts and gates painted red.
notes.roofs:
Grey tile (deepslate tile), gabled, a shallow two-pitch profile with a straight eave
oversailing one block. the gable and the one-block eave are this voice's choice.
notes.signature: A grey roofscape and grey lane walls, broken by red gates -- the colour saved for the rings within.
